name: Master of The Surge (Shadowdancer)
body:
Monks, ninjas, and martial artists who unlock the power of kinetic manipulation combine the stealth of shadow with the destructiveness of elements.

Requirements

To qualify to become a master of the surge, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Feats: Improved Unarmed Strike, Dodge, Mobility.
Skills: Stealth 5 ranks.
Special: Ki pool and kinetic blast class feature.

This alters requirements.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A master of the surge is proficient with all monk weapons and light armor, but not with shields.

This alters weapon proficiencies.

Kinesics: At every even level, a master of the surge increases her effective kineticist level for purposes of determining the highest level of wild talents she can select, the effective spell level of her kinetic blast and defense wild talents, and the amount of burn she can accept each round. She continues to gain utility wild talents and infusions as if these levels of master of the surge were levels in a class she belongs to that grants kinetic blast. She does not gain or increase other related class features, such as infusion specializations.

This replaces darkvision, shadow illusion, summon shadow, shadow call, and shadow power.

Bonus Feats

At 3rd level and every 3 level thereafter, a master of the surge gains a bonus feat from the following list: Burning Kilk, Chakra Adept, Chakra Initiate, Chakra Mandala, Chakra Master, Elemental Ki, Extra Burn, Extra Ki, Extra Ki Power, Extra Ninja Trick, and Extra Wild Talent. The master of the surge treats the flurry of blasts, elemental flurry, or flurry of stars abilities as flurry of blows for the purpose of gaining and using these feats.

This replaces rogue talents.
